name: Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are allowed on roads such as Mauna Loa Road and in most parking areas, not in many other areas.
summary: Leashed pets are allowed on roads such as Mauna Loa Road and in most parking areas, not in many other areas.

excerpts.quote: Dogs and other pets are not allowed in many areas of the park for safety reasons, and for the protection of threatened and endangered native species.

dogRules.text: Allowed on Mauna Loa Road and most parking areas, always leashed.
Pets are banned from many areas to protect nēnē and other species.
Prohibited on all trails, in undeveloped areas and wilderness, backcountry campgrounds, ʻĀinahou, Kīpuka Nēnē and all of Hilina Pali Road.
